rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a military victory when the emphasis is on winning rather than subjugating the enemy.

example.english: The conquest in this battle greatly boosted the whole army’s morale.
example.traditional: 呢場戰役嘅勝利令全軍士氣大振。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 zin3 jik6 ge3 sing3 lei6 ling6 cyun4 gwan1 si6 hei3 daai6 zan3

rows.note: Use this written noun pattern when emphasizing the subjugation of an enemy or the gaining of mastery over something, as in space exploration.

example.english: Humanity’s conquest of space still has a long way to go.
example.traditional: 人類對太空嘅征服仲有好長嘅路要行。
example.jyutping: jan4 leoi6 deoi3 taai3 hung1 ge3 zing1 fuk6 zung6 jau5 hou2 coeng4 ge3 lou6 jiu3 haang4
